entities.name: Adolé Isabelle Glitho-Akueson
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Adolé Isabelle Glitho-Akueson is a Togolese entomologist who is Professor of Animal Biology at the University of Lomé. She is the chair of UNESCO's "Women, Science and Sustainable Water Management in West Africa and Central Africa" committee and a Fellow of the African Academy of Sciences.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Adolé Isabelle Glitho-Akueson is a Togolese entomologist who is Professor of Animal Biology at the University of Lomé. She is the chair of UNESCO's "Women, Science and Sustainable Water Management in West Africa and Central Africa" committee and a Fellow of the African Academy of Sciences.
